findings.message: Unsupported: No Amount counts the opponents who had two or more lands enter the battlefield under their control this turn: EnteredThisTurn is a predicate on a permanent now on the battlefield, not a per-player count over the turn, so the number of Treasure tokens cannot be said.

Unsupported: No Amount counts the opponents who drew two or more cards this turn: there is no cards-drawn-this-turn amount and no Condition a PlayerFilter could carry to say it, so the number of cards to draw cannot be said.
